name: C072 Thầy Bói Chiến Trận (Trượng Bánh Xe Định Mệnh Tiên Tri)
prompt_ref:
Create a single-cell 1x1 reference sheet of a dark-fantasy Battle Diviner's wheel-of-fate astrolabe staff (Trượng Bánh Xe Định Mệnh Tiên Tri - C072 Thầy Bói Chiến Trận) following the exact square cell of the attached reference layout_guide_1x1.png.

COMPOSITION & ORIENTATION (100% MANDATORY):
- Draw ONE complete diviner staff oriented DIAGONALLY from bottom-left (engraved bronze and ebony shaft) to top-right (an ornate eight-spoked golden Wheel of Fate astrolabe with carved tarot runes and a glowing cyan-white clairvoyance crystal at the hub).
- Must show 100% of the entire staff from bottom tip to top astrolabe wheel with generous padding inside the frame (occupying 65%-75% of the canvas).
- Zero clipping at canvas edges.

COLOR & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Background MUST be flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) edge-to-edge.
- DO NOT use any magenta/pink tones on the staff itself (use ebony wood, antique gold, silver compass needles, and luminous cyan-white crystal).
- No character hands, no text, no borders.
prompt_card:
Create a wide horizontal 16:11 dark-fantasy card illustration featuring the exact same Wheel of Fate Astrolabe Staff (Trượng Bánh Xe Định Mệnh Tiên Tri - C072 Thầy Bói Chiến Trận) from the attached reference image.

COMPOSITION & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Place the golden Wheel of Fate astrolabe staff diagonally across the center of the horizontal frame.
- Full atmospheric dark-fantasy background (100% opaque RGB illustration, NO magenta, NO transparency): a war-tent divination altar where floating golden tarot runes and cyan foresight mirages swirl around the spinning astrolabe wheel.
- Do NOT draw any card frame, borders, or text.
